cards.explanation: The answer is a mustard seed, friends. Jesus says the kingdom of God "…is like a mustard seed that a man tossed into his garden." (Luke 13:19) Of all the seeds He could have picked, He picked that one. I'd have said chocolate chip, but that's why He's teaching and I'm stamping.

The answer is True, friends! Jesus says of the seed, "It grew and became a tree…" (Luke 13:19) One tossed seed, and it turns into a tree. I once tossed a single raisin into dough and all I got was a lumpy cookie.

The answer is the birds of the air, friends! Jesus says they "…nested in its branches." (Luke 13:19) The seed grows into a tree, and the tree gets tenants. That's a whole neighborhood from one tossed seed.

The answer is leaven, friends! Jesus says, "It is like leaven that a woman took and mixed into three measures of flour…" (Luke 13:21) That's the second picture. Leaven is what makes dough rise, and I know a thing or two about dough.
The answer is all, friends! The woman mixes the leaven in "…until all of it was leavened." (Luke 13:21) Not a corner left out, not one pocket of flour skipped. Every bit of it gets reached.
